system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Harden CentOS 9 server
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    sshd_config: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    pwquality_conf: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
  tasks:
    - name: Disable root SSH login
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: "{{ sshd_config }}"
        regexp: '^#?PermitRootLogin'
        line: 'PermitRootLogin no'
        validate: 'sshd -t -f %s'
      notify: restart sshd

    - name: Install required packages
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - openssh-server
          - fail2ban
          - audit
          - libpwquality
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Enforce password complexity settings
      ansible.builtin.blockinfile:
        path: "{{ pwquality_conf }}"
        block: |
          minlen = 14
          dcredit = -1
          ucredit = -1
          ocredit = -1
          lcredit = -1
          maxrepeat = 3
          gecoscheck = 1
          dictcheck = 1
        marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED PASSWORD POLICY"
        create: true

    - name: Ensure pwquality is enforced in PAM
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/pam.d/system-auth
        regexp: '^password\s+requisite\s+pam_pwquality.so'
        line: 'password requisite pam_pwquality.so try_first_pass local_users_only retry=3 authtok_type='
        insertbefore: '^password\s+sufficient'

    - name: Enable and start fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start auditd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: auditd
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Deploy basic audit rules
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/10-hardening.rules
        content: |
          -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k privilege_escalation
          -w /var/log/audit/ -p wa -k audit_log
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
      notify: reload auditd

  handlers:
    - name: restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

    - name: reload auditd
      ansible.builtin.command: augenrules --load
      changed_when: true
